recent_posts.title: Former GTA Developer Obbe Vermeij Releases His Nature Sandbox Game
recent_posts.summary: Former Rockstar Technical Director Obbe Vermeij has released Plentiful, a nature god sandbox game, into early access on Steam after three years of development. Players shape terrain, manage water flow, grow food, support wildlife, and keep tribes alive across 20+ levels. The game features dynamic seasons, a day/night cycle, natural disasters, a built-in level editor, and Steam Workshop support for community content.

recent_posts.title: Steam Controller sells out twice within an hour of launch
recent_posts.summary: Valve's new Steam Controller launched on May 4 at $99 and sold out within 30 minutes, crashing the Steam store in the process. A restock also sold out in under 15 minutes. The controller remains out of stock, with resellers listing units on eBay for $200 or more. Key features include drift-proof TMR thumbsticks, dual trackpads, and magnetic charging, though it only works with Steam.

recent_posts.title: Footwerk is a free Unity tool that fixes foot sliding with IK and procedural animation
recent_posts.summary: Footwerk is a free Unity add-on by Pasha Arkhipov that solves foot sliding in character locomotion by combining motion-matching and procedural movement techniques. After a wizard-based setup, the system manages per-foot states, blends raw animations with IK foot features, and ensures feet stay grounded and react to movement speed and uneven surfaces. The tool is still in development, with future additions planned including IK aiming, finger collision interaction, and facial emotion layers.

recent_posts.title: 80 Level Job Digest: Fresh Listings for Creatives
recent_posts.summary: A curated weekly job digest featuring open positions at major game studios including Valve, Epic Games, CD PROJEKT RED, Supercell, Arrowhead Game Studios, FromSoftware, and On The Spot Development. Roles span motion design, UI/UX design, level design, cinematic design, technical animation, and design management, with requirements ranging from 3+ years to 8+ years of experience.

recent_posts.title: Breakdown: Material-Driven Mesh Rotation In Unreal Engine 5
recent_posts.summary: Alina Ledeneva published a technical breakdown of a material-driven mesh reorientation system in Unreal Engine 5 using World Position Offset and custom basis logic. The breakdown covers core math principles, camera-facing geometry, target-based orientation, multi-pivot tracking on a single mesh, reactive foliage, and material-based animation for HISM crowd behavior. A performance comparison between the material-based crowd approach and skeletal animation is also included. The content is supported with images and videos and kept accessible by minimizing formula complexity.

recent_posts.title: Play Dog from This Is Fine Meme in "Metroidvania of Mental Mayhem"
recent_posts.summary: This Is Fine: Maximum Cope is a newly released Metroidvania game featuring the iconic 'This Is Fine' dog meme character, Question Hound. Developed by Hero Concept and released on May 1, the game has players face five levels themed around humiliation, fear, failure, loss, and regret. It features six bosses, six unlockable abilities, 27 perks, and 28 collectibles, with a visual style reminiscent of Cuphead and Hollow Knight. A demo and full version are available on Steam with an introductory discount.

recent_posts.title: Blender 5.2 LTS Adds New Cycles Texture Cache System
recent_posts.summary: Blender 5.2 LTS, currently in alpha with a July release expected, introduces a new Cycles Texture Cache system. It creates optimized .tx files that load only the image tiles and resolutions needed for rendering, significantly reducing memory usage in scenes with many image textures. The feature works across CPU and all GPU backends, auto-regenerates .tx files when source images change, and infers color space and filtering settings from shader node usage. It is already available in daily builds.

recent_posts.title: Free browser-based MMD animation editor powered by WebGPU
recent_posts.summary: Reze Studio is a free, browser-based MMD animation curve editor built by AmyangXYZ. It runs entirely in the browser using WebGPU with no installation required, and works on laptops, desktops, and iPads. Features include a professional timeline, dopesheet, per-channel Bézier curve editing, PMX model loading, IK, physics simulation, VMD import/export, animation layers, real-time collaboration, AI-assisted animation, mocap import from video, and mirrored paste for symmetric motion editing. The rendering engine is a custom WebGPU-powered library called reze-engine, available on GitHub.

recent_posts.title: Custom Game Engine Focused On Authentic CRT Display Simulation
recent_posts.summary: RetroEngine is a custom game engine by Alexander Rybak (AnalogDreamDev) that physically simulates CRT display behavior using DirectX 12 and C++, going beyond simple post-processing filters. The engine simulates beam movement, phosphor glow, and glass diffusion to authentically recreate the retro CRT aesthetic. Built as a passion project with minimal dependencies (only Dear ImGui), it aims to become a lightweight, approachable engine for other developers interested in retro-style rendering.

recent_posts.title: Check Out inKONBINI: One Store. Many Stories, a Cozy Slice-of-Life Sim
recent_posts.summary: inKONBINI: One Store. Many Stories, a cozy narrative-driven slice-of-life simulation game from Nagai Industries, has launched on PC and console. Set in early 1990s Japan, players take on the role of a college student working in a small-town convenience store, handling daily tasks while building relationships with customers through branching dialogue and meaningful choices. The game has received Very Positive reviews on Steam. A 30-page digital artbook offering a behind-the-scenes look at the game's creation is also now available for purchase.
